summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filing by Oaktree Strategic Credit Fund, a closed-end fund, reporting a regular monthly distribution and its monthly NAV per share as of March 31, 2026. The board declared a gross distribution of $0.1600 per share across all classes, with net amounts varying by share class. The filing also includes a portfolio update (NAV ~$4.4B, portfolio fair value ~$7.0B, debt ~$2.6B, leverage 0.57x) and a status update on its continuous public offering of up to $5.0B in shares. There is no special situation event — no M&A, tender offer, restructuring, activist campaign, or other corporate event of the type addressed by special situations categories.
